title: works well enuf, almost too narrow for me to clean
text:
works well enuf, almost too narrow for me to clean. howdy y'all,

this item works quite well. i got this _specific_ version of the product for the added ice shaver. that works amazingly well. [*grin*]

my only complaint is that the containers are a tad too narrow for my hands. there are four ridges on the inside of the containers - structural supports, i presume - that make cleaning them rather painful. i have to be _very_ careful or my pointer finger knuckle will end up literally black-n-blue with bruises.

however, i am 6'1" and my hands - while not large - are also not small. [*grin*] i presume that standard sized folks will not have the same bruised hands that i so often get. i _can_ avoid the bruises if i am careful, but i am somewhat absent minded. [*sigh ...*]

i use this to make veggie smoothies with a little bit of veggie and a lot of fruit. it works well and my doctor has been quite complimentary on my improved health from the increased veggie intake.

rated a THREE since it does what it ought to - no more and no less.

take care,
lee
